51.title: Feliz Navidad
51.lyrics:
Feliz Navidad
Feliz Navidad
Feliz Navidad
Prospero Ano y Felicidad. (x2)
We wanna wish you a Merry Christmas
We wanna wish you a Merry Christmas
We wanna wish you a Merry Christmas
From the bottom of our heart (2)
Singing hallelujah...
Singing hallelujah...
Singing hallelujah...
From my heart
From my heart
Come hear this music
On this brand new morning
Come and share this feeling
On this Christmas day
Yes, my heart is singing
Christmas bells are ringing
with our hearts over flowing
Love is here to stay
Singing hallelujah...

100.title: I have decided
100.lyrics:
1. I have decided to follow Jesus
I have decided to follow Jesus
I have decided to follow Jesus

No turning back. No turning back.

2. Though all may leave me Still I will follow (3)
No turning back. No turning back.

3. The Cross before me The world behind me (3)
No turning back. No turning back.

4. Will you decide now, to follow jesus (3)
No turning back. No turning back.
